speaker.name: Christian Carballo Lozano
speaker.title: Principal Tech Advisor, AI at Plain Concepts
speaker.bio: Christian Carballo Lozano is a Mathematician and a Principal Tech Advisor at Plain Concepts, where he helps organizations design and build Machine Learning and AI solutions from architecture to production. His focus is on turning AI capabilities into robust, scalable solutions for real-world applications.

talks.title: Tu agente de IA funciona. ¿Y ahora qué? Del prototipo a producción
